name: quality
description: Code quality operations: pre-commit checks, auto-fix, and validation.
when_to_use: Before commit, after code changes, to fix lint/format/type errors or run validation (schema, roadmap_sync).
workflow_sequences: skill_pack(operation="execute", pack_name="quality") — runs gate → autofix → gate cycle automatically
troubleshooting_tips: Run execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=["quality"]) to get lint, format, type_check in one call.
If execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=["fix_quality"]) fails with connection error, retry once; then rely on execute_pre_commit_checks for gates.
Use skill_pack(operation="execute", pack_name="quality") for the full gate→autofix→gate retry loop without manual orchestration.
